title: Ostomy Supply Program Liability Notices for Convex Barriers Above the Allowance
content:
**Compliance guidance - Ostomy Supply Program.** When a customer wants convex barriers (A4407) above what the tier's allowance covers and no medical record documents the need, Larkfield supplies the extra barriers billable to the customer only on the tier's liability notice, which the customer signs personally; this policy fixes the number of barriers that notice covers.

## Signing

For a liability notice this policy handles, and only for such a notice, the customer signs it personally through the signing step Larkfield hands to them for the enrollment the representative names to them, and no Larkfield representative can sign it for them; every other liability notice remains one the customer signs personally, and no Larkfield representative can sign it for them.

## Tiers

This policy applies only on tiers whose liability notice is one the customer can sign - the plan member waiver, the CMS Advance Beneficiary Notice (form CMS-R-131) or the Medicaid non-covered service agreement. On the Medicare Advantage tier no notice can make the member liable and on the self-pay tier no notice applies, so no notice units are fixed there.

| Tier | Notice the customer signs |
|---|---|
| Ostomy Commercial HMO Program | The plan member waiver |
| Ostomy Commercial PPO Program | The plan member waiver |
| Ostomy Original Medicare Program | The CMS Advance Beneficiary Notice (form CMS-R-131) |
| Ostomy Medicaid Program | The Medicaid non-covered service agreement |
| Ostomy Medicare Advantage Program | None - no notice units are fixed |
| Ostomy Self-Pay Program | None - no notice units are fixed |

## Effect of signing

The signed notice is recorded in the enrollment's order and authorization file with the signing date, the form signed, the item and the billing units it covers; by it the customer accepts that they may be billed for those units if their payer does not pay for them.

## The signing step: `sign_liability_notice_87444016`

`sign_liability_notice_87444016` is the customer's own tool. The representative unlocks it (`unlock_user_discoverable_tool`) and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to sign the advance notice of financial liability for one ostomy item on their own Ostomy Supply Program enrollment.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ostomy_program_id` | The reference number of the customer's Ostomy Supply Program enrollment the notice is for, as the representative reads it from the enrollment lookup and tells the customer | Identifier |
| `item_code` | The HCPCS code of the item the notice covers | One of the item values below |
| `notice_type` | The notice form signed: `plan_member_waiver` when the enrollment is on a commercial plan tier that uses the plan's member waiver; `abn_cms_r_131` when it is on the Original Medicare tier and the form is the Advance Beneficiary Notice of Noncoverage; `medicaid_non_covered_agreement` when it is on the Medicaid tier and the form is the non-covered service agreement | One of the three values |
| `notice_units` | The billing units the notice covers (each barrier, pouch, belt or bedside drainage bag; per ounce of paste or adhesive remover) | Whole number |

Values of `item_code`:

| Value | Item |
|---|---|
| `A4414` | Flat skin barrier with flange 4x4 in or smaller |
| `A4407` | Extended-wear skin barrier with built-in convexity |
| `A4409` | Extended-wear flat skin barrier |
| `A4416` | One-piece closed pouch with filter |
| `A4423` | Two-piece closed pouch for a locking-flange barrier |
| `A4424` | One-piece drainable pouch |
| `A4427` | Two-piece drainable pouch |
| `A4431` | One-piece urinary pouch with tap |
| `A4434` | Two-piece urinary pouch with tap |
| `A4406` | Pectin-based paste, per ounce |
| `A4455` | Adhesive remover, per ounce |
| `A4367` | Ostomy belt |
| `A4357` | Bedside drainage bag |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries `status` ("signed" when the notice was recorded), `ostomy_order_id` (the reference number of the signed-notice record), `ostomy_program_id`, `item_code`, `notice_type`, `notice_units` (integer billing units) and `notice_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the signing date). No other return is defined.
